connection_condition: budget rows carry an event identifier corresponding to the event record identifier
description: A budget line is part of exactly one event; an event may have several budget lines, one per expense category, and budget rows cannot exist without their event.

connection_condition: attendance rows carry an event identifier corresponding to the event record identifier
description: An attendance record is part of an event and has no meaning without it; each attendance record pairs one member with one event.

connection_condition: expense rows carry a budget identifier corresponding to the budget-line identifier
description: An expense is charged to one budget line; removing the budget line would leave the expense without an allocation context.

connection_condition: attendance rows carry a member identifier corresponding to the member record identifier
description: An attendance record belongs to one member and cannot exist without that member.

connection_condition: expense rows carry a member identifier corresponding to the member record identifier
description: An expense is incurred by one member and cannot exist without that member.

connection_condition: member records carry a major identifier corresponding to the major record identifier; one member has no value
description: A member declares an academic major, giving access to the major name and its department. This is a reference relationship, not a type hierarchy.

connection_condition: member records carry a ZIP code corresponding to the ZIP record identifier
description: A member's home location is expressed through a ZIP code area, which provides city, county, and state attributes.

connection_condition: each ZIP row carries a city or place name
description: Each ZIP code area is labeled with one city or place name.

connection_condition: each ZIP row carries a county name
description: Each ZIP code area is labeled with one county or municipio name.

connection_condition: each ZIP row carries a full state name and a two-letter state abbreviation
description: Each ZIP code area belongs to one state or territory, recorded both as a full name and as a two-letter abbreviation.

connection_condition: each major row carries its name
description: A major is identified by its academic program name.

connection_condition: each major row carries its offering department
description: A major is offered by one department or school, which answers department-level questions about a member's study.

connection_condition: the event status column and the budget event status column carry identical values for every event that has budget rows
description: The lifecycle status of an event is represented twice: on the event record and repeated on each budget row. They express the same business concept and agree on all observed budget rows.

connection_condition: given-name column of the member record
description: The full name is derived by combining the member's given name with the family name.

connection_condition: family-name column of the member record
description: The full name is derived by combining the member's given name with the family name.

connection_condition: spent amount is the numerator of the ratio
description: The spend-to-budget ratio is derived from the spent amount and the allocated amount.

connection_condition: allocated amount is the denominator of the ratio
description: The spend-to-budget ratio is derived from the spent amount and the allocated amount.

connection_condition: spent amount is the amount actually consumed
description: Budget overrun is derived from the spent amount and the allocated amount; it is positive when spending exceeds the allocation.

connection_condition: allocated amount is the amount available
description: Budget overrun is derived from the spent amount and the allocated amount; it is zero or negative when spending is within budget.

connection_condition: counting attendance records grouped by event
description: Attendance count is derived from the number of attendance records for an event.

connection_condition: summing individual expense costs within a group
description: Total expense cost is derived by summing individual expense costs over a selected set of expense records.

connection_condition: averaging individual expense costs within a group
description: Average expense cost is derived by computing the arithmetic mean of individual expense costs over a selected set of expense records.

connection_condition: indirect: expenses reference budget lines, and budget lines reference events
description: Event-level spending is reached indirectly through budget lines; an event's expenses are those charged to any of its budget lines.
